summary.text: Yes. Submit another change in Account settings with your Singpass. Your latest request replaces the earlier one.

details.heading: What happens next
details.body: Your most recent request replaces the earlier request. The changes take effect after the 12-hour cooling period.

steps.name: Submit the new change
steps.text: Use the Account settings page with your Singpass to submit further changes to your contact details.

example_phrasings: Can I make further changes to my contact details while my current request is still in the 12-hour cooling period?
Can I change my contact details again?
Can I make further changes while my request is cooling?

sources.page_title: Can I make further changes to my contact details while my current request is still in the 12-hour cooling period?

quotes.text: Yes, you can submit further changes to your contact details via the Account settings page with your Singpass.
Please note that your most recent request will supersede the previous submission and the changes will take effect after the 12-hour cooling period.
